d: A crusading newspaper editor recruits his old friend Hoppy to take the job of marshal in a town rife with vice and murder directed at helpless miners.
Hoppy, Johnny and Windy fight a malicious gang trying to stop a cattle drive from reaching a drought-stricken North.
A family feud involves Matt when the son is accused of theft.
A rancher (Randolph Scott) hunts down those responsible for killing his wife during a Wells Fargo holdup.

Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach.
